after.name: Question 1
after.problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $5{x}^{2}-6{y}^{2}=60$ in standard form.
after.worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a horizontal hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $60$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5{x}^{2}-6{y}^{2} & =60 \\ \frac{5{x}^{2}}{60}-\frac{6{y}^{2}}{60} & =\frac{60}{60} \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{12}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{10} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

content.problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $5{x}^{2}-6{y}^{2}=60$ in standard form.
content.worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a horizontal hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $60$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5{x}^{2}-6{y}^{2} & =60 \\ \frac{5{x}^{2}}{60}-\frac{6{y}^{2}}{60} & =\frac{60}{60} \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{12}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{10} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

after.problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $5{y}^{2}-6{x}^{2}=30$ in standard form.
after.worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a vertical hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{y}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $30$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5{y}^{2}-6{x}^{2} & =30 \\ \frac{5{y}^{2}}{30}-\frac{6{x}^{2}}{30} & =\frac{30}{30} \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{6}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{5} & =1\end{aligned}
$$

content.problem: Write the equation of the hyperbola $5{y}^{2}-6{x}^{2}=30$ in standard form.
content.worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a vertical hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{y}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $30$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}5{y}^{2}-6{x}^{2} & =30 \\ \frac{5{y}^{2}}{30}-\frac{6{x}^{2}}{30} & =\frac{30}{30} \\ \frac{{y}^{2}}{6}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{5} & =1\end{aligned}
$$
